ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.subtitle: Quarterly summary: performance, position and growth.
ranking.readOnly: This page is read-only. Grades are entered in the journal.
ranking.filterHint: Choose the academic year, quarter and scope.
ranking.topNHint: Leave empty to show the whole list.
ranking.needQuarter: This academic year has no quarters. Add quarters first.
ranking.needClass: Select a class to see the ranking.
ranking.needParallel: Select a grade level to see the ranking.
ranking.noYears: No academic year found. Create one first.
ranking.noStudents: No active students in this scope.
ranking.noData: No grades have been entered for this quarter yet.
ranking.parentNotice: You only see your child's row. The position is calculated across the whole class.
ranking.tableHint: Positions are dense: an equal score gets an equal position.
ranking.medalHint: The top three positions are marked with a trophy icon.
ranking.settingsHint: Coefficients are stored in the database and apply to everyone.
ranking.penaltyFactorHint: 50 means each penalty point removes 0.50 points.
ranking.formulaHint: Final score = (grade x weight + test x weight) / total weight - penalty points x factor. The result always stays between 0 and 100.
ranking.testMissingHint: The tests module is not ready yet. Without a test result the grade weight becomes 100%.
ranking.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change the formula.
ranking.chartSubjectsHint: Each subject is a separate chart with its own colour.
ranking.chartOverallHint: By final score. The top three are highlighted.
ranking.chartQuarterHint: Class average per subject for the selected quarter.
ranking.chartYearHint: Each quarter has its own colour. Growth or decline is visible here.
ranking.chartLimitHint: The chart shows the top {count} students. The table stays complete.
ranking.noChartData: Not enough data for a chart.
